title: Lean LFM-to-Dirac Derivation
description: Noncanonical Lean 4 research derivation through DIRAC-022. Starting from a positive two-field C19 action, the artifact derives a massive C19 Klein-Gordon tangent, a cubical four-component Dirac continuum square root, density/current, copy, spin, classification and transport results. DIRAC-021 derives the native zero-momentum rest frequency and opposite-energy phases. DIRAC-022 then reuses the Hamiltonian momentum-response velocity to prove the normalized coherent positive/negative branch zitterbewegung expectation: angular frequency 38, position amplitude sqrt(12)/38, and peak-to-peak native reduced Compton length sqrt(12)/19. Pure branches, same-sign branches, incoherent mixtures and a wrong-mass reconstruction are explicit controls. The result does not prove exact native finite-spacing Dirac evolution, uniform fixed-time convergence, localized nonlinear native-electron trembling, an SI scale, a physical electron, or electromagnetic coupling.
